ABOUT THE ROLE
Single Grain is at an inflection point: product must now drive revenue growth.
We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Product Engineer who builds like a founder and thinks like a product owner. You'll identify the highest-leverage product opportunities, ship them end-to-end, measure their revenue impact, and iterate until the numbers move. You'll use AI to compound your output and reduce cycle times.
You don't just use AI occasionally — you've built repeatable workflows with it, quantified the time it saves you, and actively look for more ways to apply it.

* Not a single-discipline specialist.
